verdict.rationale: One marketing line says Lorikeet's agent "takes action through your APIs and MCP servers" inside workflows, which suggests MCP-client support. However, there is no setup documentation or corroboration. The extensive MCP-server docs (connecting Claude or ChatGPT to Lorikeet) are the opposite role and are not credited here. Missing for 10: docs on how to register or configure external MCP servers, details on supported transports and authentication, how MCP tools are scoped in workflows, and any independent or hands-on confirmation.
